id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a 422 from the reporting events sync

review.posthog_relevance: Defines a permanent failure classification for Chatwoot warehouse ingestion, preventing unnecessary retry loops for requests that will always fail with the same error.
review.reason: Adds a 422 Client Error entry to the non-retryable error dictionary, including a comment explaining that the request is deterministic and retrying does not change the outcome. Adds a unit test asserting that a 422 response results in an HTTPError, exactly one request, and the specific user-facing message, while also checking that the message matches the dictionary entry.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded correctness improvement (preventing redundant retries for a specific, deterministic failure). However, the broader systemic impact on warehouse ingestion reliability or recovery is not demonstrated by the supplied hunk observations, which focus narrowly on the error classification and its associated test. No unverified P
